_readme: Accessibility findings that are known and not yet fixed. Keyed by rule@normalised-selector;
see tests/support/a11y.mjs for why the selector is normalised and why this file can only shrink.
Every entry needs a note saying what it costs a user, and an issue tracking the fix. An entry
without both is rejected when the file loads — a finding silenced for no recorded reason is the
same as one nobody looked at.
Regenerate with: npm run test:a11y:record   (then write the notes; the placeholders fail)
